thread:
alex: Heads-up — proposing an RBAC change for ci-snapshot-restorer service account. Need quick signoff, impacts KMS decrypt path and snapshot tagging.

mara: What exactly are you changing? Any risk to current restores?

alex: Switching away from a long-lived KMS decrypt principal. CI will request ephemeral delegated grants for KMS decrypt via our grant-service, then impersonate the short-lived grant to perform restores.
Example of the planned grant creation command:
```
# create ephemeral grant with 1h TTL
gcloud kms grants create \
  --key=projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/ck --principal=serviceAccount:ci-grant@p.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --ttl=3600 --purpose=DECRYPT
```
This avoids baking decrypt perms into a long-lived SA.

riley: Two questions: (1) Will Cloud Audit Logs show who initiated the grant and the impersonator? (2) Does the grant-service rotate its own key material or rely on KMS grants only?

danny: (1) Yes — create/grant operations are logged under ADMIN_ACTIVITY and will have principalName and request metadata, provided our log-export pipeline includes "serviceName:"cloudkms.googleapis.com".
(2) grant-service holds no private keys; it requests KMS to create grants and returns a GRANT_ID. TTL enforced by KMS. We should set TTL <= 1h for CI.
Note: ensure audit log sinks include protoPayload.methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.CreateCryptoKeyVersion" and grant create ops.

platform-bot: ci-pipeline #8245: deploy completed :white_check_mark: (pipeline: snapshots/ephemeral-grants) 

oncall: Flag: snapshot tagging. Current compliance filters rely on a 'created-by' snapshot label written by the old SA. New flow needs tag-write permission or a separate tagging step. Otherwise our retention/erase jobs will miss them.

alex: Good catch. I'll add roles/compute.snapshotLabelEditor on the bucket and snapshot resource. Also adding this audit query for compliance checks:
```
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.request
FROM `project.audit_logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE resource.type = "gce_snapshot" AND protoPayload.methodName = "v1.snapshots.insert"
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(protoPayload.request.labels) WHERE key = "created-by")
```

mara: Can we run this in staging first? Steps?

alex: Steps: 1) create ephemeral grant-service in staging, 2) update CI pipeline to use new grant call, 3) run a test restore of a 20GB snapshot, 4) verify logs & labels, 5) promote change. I'll open a PR with RBAC diff.

danny: I'll take smoke test tomorrow morning and post results. cc @oncall

oncall: Thanks team — please tag the PR with "sec-review" and include the audit query in the docs. :thumbsup:
